svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: The Gini coefficient measures inequality on a scale from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher inequality.
Inequality is measured here in terms of income before taxes and benefits.
